interfaces.name: Command line
interfaces.what: Every command a person or their coding agent types to build, check, edit or ship a map.

interfaces.name: Method quality command line
interfaces.what: A second command line for whoever changes the instructions. It scores maps and reads finished builds.

interfaces.name: Map viewer
interfaces.what: The browser page that shows a map, and every address that page fetches its data and its source from.

interfaces.name: Build skill
interfaces.what: The file a coding agent reads when a person types the slash command. It points the agent at the instructions.

interfaces.name: Developer skills
interfaces.what: Two more files a coding agent reads. One scores a map's quality, the other reviews a finished build.

interfaces.name: Map folder
interfaces.what: What a project commits beside its code: the stored map, its readable view, the code survey and the build stamp.

interfaces.name: Settings
interfaces.what: Values set outside a browser: the ignore list beside a map, and the environment variables the tools read.

interfaces.name: Project source
interfaces.what: The mapped project's own files and history, read as they stood at the commit the map is pinned to.

interfaces.name: Code editor
interfaces.what: A reader's own editor, opened at the exact file and line a map box points at.

interfaces.name: Code host
interfaces.what: A web page showing a mapped file at the pinned commit, for a reader without the project on their machine.

interfaces.name: Coding agent chat logs
interfaces.what: The conversation files a coding agent leaves behind, read to say what a finished build did and what it cost.

interfaces.name: Score and review reports
interfaces.what: The folder each scoring run and each build review writes into, for the person who changed the instructions to read.

blocks.name: What gets mapped
blocks.purpose: Decides which of a project's files a map describes, and how coarsely.

blocks.name: What counts as a way in
blocks.purpose: Decides whether a command or an address is a door into the product, or something the product owns.

blocks.name: What counts as an outside surface
blocks.purpose: Decides where the product ends, what kind of thing each edge is, and who stands on the far side.

blocks.name: When a map is well formed
blocks.purpose: Decides which findings stop a build, which only advise, and what a written reason may silence.

blocks.name: How a claim is grounded
blocks.purpose: Decides what counts as a claim being challenged, and what a partial pass is allowed to record.

blocks.name: Which line an anchor may point at
blocks.purpose: Decides which line stands as evidence for a claim, and when a stored one has drifted.

blocks.name: How elements are grouped
blocks.purpose: Decides how many boxes a screen may hold, and what regrouping is allowed to change.

blocks.name: What a screen may show
blocks.purpose: Decides which view a thing belongs to, and which facts a picture may leave off a box.

blocks.name: What a build may read and write
blocks.purpose: Decides which files a build may open, and where a change has to be written to survive.

blocks.name: Who may reach a served map
blocks.purpose: Decides which requests the local map server answers, and which files it will hand back.

blocks.name: When two maps may be compared
blocks.purpose: Decides whether two scores are comparable at all, and how far a measurement may move.

subdomains.name: Map content
subdomains.purpose: Everything a map says about the project it describes.

subdomains.name: Product story
subdomains.purpose: Who the product is for, what they want from it, and the ordered steps each goal takes.

subdomains.name: Code inventory
subdomains.purpose: The pieces the product is built from, what it pulls in from outside, and how they are wired.

subdomains.name: Stored data
subdomains.purpose: The types the product keeps, where each one lives, and the states it moves through.

subdomains.name: Outside edge and decisions
subdomains.purpose: Where the product meets the world, and the decisions it enforces at those places.

subdomains.name: Operations
subdomains.purpose: How the product is run, watched, configured and tested.

subdomains.name: Map file
subdomains.purpose: The stored map itself, the workers' rows it is merged from, and the record of how its claims held up.

subdomains.name: Build directives
subdomains.purpose: The declared edits a build applies every time the map is rebuilt from its rows.

subdomains.name: Code survey shapes
subdomains.purpose: What the measuring pass finds in a code tree before any map is drawn.

subdomains.name: Viewer shapes
subdomains.purpose: The drawn form of a map: boxes, arrows and pages, built fresh for each screen.

deployment.runs_on: the person's own machine, in the same folder-local Python environment the main command line uses
deployment.exposed_as: a second command typed in a terminal, for whoever changes the instructions
deployment.config_source: Declared as its own console command in pyproject.toml:46, from a package that lives beside the main one and depends on it.
